typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	OLEDBCommand_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		kriName as string,
		effDate as date,
		metricValue as string,
		{Column 1} as string,
		{Column 0} as string,
		{Column 2} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource	source(output(
		kriName as string,
		effDate as string,
		metricValue as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
FlatFileSource derive(effDay = notConvertedectfunctiondateday(effDate),
		effMonth = month(effDate),
		effYear = year(effDate)) ~> DerivedColumneffDatesplit
DerivedColumneffDatesplit derive(effDayDerived = iif((length(toString(effDay)) > 1), toString(effDay), '0' + toString(effDay)),
		effMonthDerived = iif((length(toString(effMonth)) > 1), toString(effMonth), '0' + toString(effMonth)),
		effYearDerived = toString(effYear)) ~> DerivedColumneffDateaddzerosifneeded
DerivedColumneffDateaddzerosifneeded derive(effDateDerived = toString((effMonthDerived + '/' + effDayDerived + '/' + effYearDerived))) ~> DerivedColumneffDateFinalFormat
DerivedColumneffDateFinalFormat,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Column 0} == LookupLKPTABLE@kriName && effDateDerived == LookupLKPTABLE@effDate,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		effDateDerived = effDateDerived,
		effDayDerived = effDayDerived,
		effMonthDerived = effMonthDerived,
		effYearDerived = effYearDerived,
		effDay = effDay,
		effMonth = effMonth,
		effYear = effYear,
		kriName = FlatFileSource@kriName,
		effDate = DerivedColumneffDatesplit@effDate,
		metricValue = FlatFileSource@metricValue,
		{Column 1} = {Column 1},
		{Column 0} = {Column 0},
		{Column 2} = {Column 2}
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupIsMatch@Match sink(input(
		{Column 2} as string,
		{Column 0} as string,
		{Column 1} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{Column 2} = Param_0,
		{Column 0} = Param_1,
		{Column 1} = Param_2),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBCommand_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBCommand
LookupIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		kriName as string,
		effDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		metricValue as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		kriName = {Column 0},
		effDate = {Column 1},
		metricValue = {Column 2}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
